integrity: Proof reconstructed using the defining divisor-sum equation, congruence and abundancy arguments; exact integer certificate run and source comparisons recorded. Not an independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Necessary prime-support bounds only: existence of squarefree near-3-perfect integers is not asserted; the lower bounds 15 and 122 may not be optimal. An equivalent theorem in unindexed literature is possible. Exact comparisons use integers and a standalone reproducible checker.
title: Prime-support barriers for squarefree near-3-perfect integers
